mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if structural wall framing is done incorrectly?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are putting load on the wrong members, undersizing headers, skipping bracing, or framing over a moving foundation issue. Those mistakes can lead to cracked finishes, doors that stick, unsafe settling, and expensive tear-outs after inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bad framing can cause unsafe load transfer, cracked finishes, sticking doors, and failed inspections. The biggest risk is hiding a structural problem instead of fixing it.
